answer:
I don't know the exact figure, and it may have changed since my training data. From what I recall, the Windows installer is a few hundred megabytes to about 1 GB to download, and the installed footprint is roughly 1 to 4 GB. The main variable is the GPU runner libraries (CUDA and especially ROCm), which make up most of the size. The binary itself is small. Models are stored separately, by default under `%USERPROFILE%\.ollama\models`.

To get an accurate number on your machine, install Ollama and then run this in PowerShell:

```powershell
"{0:N2} GB" -f ((Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Ollama" -Recurse -File | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum / 1GB)
```
